answer: In Proof of Agent, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces topological cut verifications across interaction graphs. An adversary attempting to partition graph flows must post bonded collateral per identity; auditing agents cross-verify boundary integrity to extract a cryptographic signal of fraud. Detected colluding clusters trigger immediate stake slashing, imposing superlinear attacker cost that scales exponentially with cut size. A solitary Sybil dune cannot hide: dishonest nodes forfeit capital to an ocean of honest validators.
